highlights.description: Initial release of capability-stack-spec with Go types, validation, CLI, and rendering
JSON Schema for defining capability stacks with layers, categories, and PRISM integration
D2 diagram and static HTML rendering with interactive Lit web component

added.description: Enum constants and validators for CapabilityStatus, Priority, Domain, Phase, NistCsfFunction, ToolType, ToolStatus, Framework
Core types: Metadata, Layer, Category, Tool, FrameworkMapping, PRISMRef, PRISMIntegration, LevelCriteria
Capability type with lifecycle status, dependencies, tooling, and framework mappings
CapabilityStack root document type with getter methods for querying capabilities
Comprehensive validation: required fields, kebab-case IDs, enum values, reference integrity, dependency cycle detection
JSON Schema generation from Go types using invopop/jsonschema with embedded schema accessors
`capstack validate` command for document validation with detailed error reporting
`capstack init` command for creating new capability stack documents from templates
`capstack list` command with filtering by status, layer, and tag
`capstack show` command for displaying capability details including PRISM integration
D2 diagram rendering with default style (dependency arrows) and grid style (executive view)
Static HTML rendering with embeddable fragments or standalone documents, light/dark themes
`capstack render` command supporting D2 and HTML output formats
Lit web component `<capability-stack>` for embedding in websites and MkDocs
Interactive tooltips, status legend, and foundational capabilities in web component

documentation.description: README with CLI usage, Go library examples, and key concepts
Getting started guide for maturity workflow
Web component usage and MkDocs integration guide

tests.description: Unit tests for constants, validation, and CapabilityStack methods
Render tests for D2 and HTML output

build.description: GitHub Actions workflows for CI, linting, and SAST
